canonical_project: Metfone / Viettel (Cambodia) IDC and core-network data center
notes: Metfone (Viettel Cambodia), the country's largest mobile operator, maintains core-network/IDC data center infrastructure in Phnom Penh (PeeringDB lists Viettel (Cambodia) Pte. Ltd. in Phnom Penh). Public documentation of a commercial colocation facility and capacity in MW is limited; evidence graded C.
